messages:
zoe: quick report: found awkward UX in go-sdk generator streaming when callers try to cancel during auth refresh. Next() blocks and people end up spawning goroutine hacks.

ben: can you paste the minimal repro? curious if leak is in auth refresh or iterator.

zoe: tiny repro: create ctx, it := client.Generator().Stream(ctx, req); spawn goroutine that cancels ctx while iterator is mid-block; runtime.NumGoroutine() climbs.

lia: looked at auth code: refresh spawns a goroutine per attempt and listens on an internal done chan that is not tied to the request ctx in cached-token path. easy fix: pass ctx into refresh and select on ctx.Done().

ben: ergonomics side: we should add a non-breaking NextContext(ctx) (or NextWithContext) to let callers unblock without breaking existing API. keep Next() as wrapper to preserve compatibility and deprecate later.

zoe: agree. add example in README showing NextContext usage and an examples helper returning an iterator paired with a cancel func so copy-paste users are safe.

lia: i'll draft a patch: wire ctx into auth refresh + add NextContext + tests (TestGeneratorNextContextCancel). will update examples and add changelog note.

ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-1102 for audit of other clients using same pattern.

ben: nice, thanks. small PR nit: name the method `NextContext` rather than `NextWithContext` for consistency with stdlib.

zoe: agreed on NextContext. thanks! will watch the PR.
